description: Relation vocabulary for GLiREL zero-shot relation extraction queries. These labels are QUERIES to the extractor, NOT evidence that the relation exists.

extraction_relations.CAUSES: A causes or brings about B
extraction_relations.REQUIRES: A requires or depends on B
extraction_relations.MECHANISTICALLY_RELATED_TO: A is mechanistically related to B
extraction_relations.STRUCTURALLY_RELATED_TO: A is structurally related to B
extraction_relations.FUNCTIONALLY_RELATED_TO: A is functionally related to B

b2_inference_rules.COMPOSITION: combines a process/capability from one source with a substrate/mediator from the other
b2_inference_rules.ABSTRACTION: identifies a shared abstract category that subsumes specific instances in both sources
b2_inference_rules.SPECIALIZATION: applies a general principle from one source to a specific case in the other
b2_inference_rules.GENERALIZATION: generalizes from two specific instances to a broader rule
b2_inference_rules.CAUSAL_TRANSFER: transfers a causal mechanism from one source to a system in the other
b2_inference_rules.MECHANISTIC_ANALOGY: asserts mechanistic analogy between mechanisms in the two sources
b2_inference_rules.STRUCTURAL_ANALOGY: asserts structural correspondence between entities in the two sources
b2_inference_rules.FUNCTIONAL_ANALOGY: asserts functional correspondence between entities in the two sources
b2_inference_rules.OTHER: derivation does not fit any of the above; requires independent adjudication

provenance_labels.SOURCE_LOCAL_RELATION: relation fully contained within one source
provenance_labels.CROSS_SOURCE_RELATION: relation requires evidence from both sources

note: All relation labels are EXTRACTION QUERIES. GLiREL returning a relation with high score does NOT mean the relation is scientifically valid. The downstream B-2 semantic adjudicator (frozen, commit f905b68) remains authoritative.
